readmeHtml:
Tinycast

A native macOS launcher for everyday productivity. Lightweight and open source.

Website · Install · Docs · Support


Built with SwiftUI and AppKit. No dependencies, no Electron, no telemetry. It runs your Raycast extensions, too.

Explore all features →

For anything private, feel free to email hello@tinycast.dev.

Install

On an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer:

brew install --cask tinycast
brew install --cask tinycast@beta
  • DMG: notarized, download from Releases. Drag Tinycast.app to /Applications.
  • Intel Mac: install from Homebrew tap.

Support

Tinycast is free and stays free. If it earns a place on your Mac, consider supporting its development. Thank you!

License

Tinycast is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 license.

releases.name: Tinycast Beta 0.12.14-beta.141
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Move Tinycast to the com.abueammar.tinycast bundle id by @abue-ammar in #1910

### ⚠️ One-time move: Tinycast Beta has a new app ID

This update moves Tinycast Beta to a new app ID, `com.abueammar.tinycast.beta`. That is a step toward iCloud sync.

**Update in the app as usual: click Update, then Relaunch.** Tinycast reopens in a moment with everything you had: settings and shortcuts, clipboard history, notes, snippets (with their shortcuts), quicklinks, AI chats, extensions, window layouts and rooms. Open at Login stays as it was.

**macOS treats the new ID as a new app, so do these once after the update:**

1. **Grant permissions again.** Open **Settings → Permissions** in Tinycast, or **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, and turn on Tinycast Beta for **Accessibility**, plus **Full Disk Access** if you use File Search. Until you do, pasting, snippet expansion, the Hyper Key and window commands do not work.
2. **Remove the old entry.** System Settings may now list Tinycast Beta twice. The old entry does nothing: select it and click **–**.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly efficient, fully native macOS launcher optimized for low memory usage.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Tinycast is a fully native macOS launcher designed to be incredibly resource-efficient. It provides quick access to frequently used applications and tools via a single hotkey. The application maintains a minimal footprint, consuming under 100 MB of RAM while running in the background. Built specifically for macOS 26 or later, it leverages native APIs for maximum performance and responsiveness. This makes it an ideal alternative to heavier launcher tools for users who prioritize system efficiency.
keyFeatures: Native macOS application: built directly for the platform ensuring tight integration.
Single hotkey activation: provides instant access to core functionality with one keystroke.
Low memory footprint: operates consistently while consuming less than 100 MB of RAM.
Swift 6.0 codebase: utilizes modern Swift features for safety and performance.
Open source licensing: distributed under the AGPL-3.0 license for community inspection.
